name: sketchup-mcp
description: Lets Claude read, take off quantities, model, tag, run Ruby and export images in SketchUp desktop (2017 or later, tested on 2021 and 2023).
long_description:
Connects Claude to the open SketchUp model through the **SU MCP Bridge** extension (socket 127.0.0.1:9876).

- No Python or Node.js install needed: runs on the Node.js built into Claude Desktop.
- First time: ask Claude to run the `install_sketchup_bridge` tool (or install `su_mcp.rbz` via Extension Manager), then restart SketchUp.
- Interior tag standard (FL floor, WL wall, CL ceiling, SK skirting, DR door, FN furniture, LT lighting...) and a bill of quantities by tag and by room (`interior_takeoff`, CSV for Excel).
- Units: lengths in mm, areas in m², volumes in m³. Every model edit is one Undo step.
- If another server named `"sketchup"` (for example an older SketchUp MCP) is declared in `claude_desktop_config.json`, remove that entry after installing this extension to avoid duplicate tools.

tools.name: quantity_takeoff
tools.description: Quantity takeoff by tag or material

tools.name: interior_takeoff
tools.description: Interior bill of quantities by tag and by room (floors, walls, ceilings, items), CSV for Excel

tools.name: create_shape
tools.description: Draw a polygon face, optional pushpull

tools.name: insert_component
tools.description: Insert a component from a .skp file or a definition

tools.name: setup_tags
tools.description: Create tags with the interior tag standard (folders, colors)

tools.name: make_group
tools.description: Group entities (e.g. a room: named group without a tag)

tools.name: run_ruby
tools.description: Run arbitrary Ruby code in SketchUp

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the viewport for Claude to see

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Export the viewport as an image file

tools.name: export_file
tools.description: Export the model to a 3D/2D file

tools.name: install_sketchup_bridge
tools.description: Install/update the SU MCP Bridge extension in SketchUp

port.title: SketchUp bridge port
port.description: TCP port of SU MCP Bridge (default 9876). Change it only if needed; it must also be changed in SketchUp via Extensions > SU MCP Bridge > Change port..., and SketchUp restarted.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for SketchUp to answer one command (a quantity takeoff on a large model can take a while).
